mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_knowledge_gap (question_hash, question, scope_id, miss_count, first_seen_at_ms, last_seen_at_ms, retrieval_path, source_agent_code, source_channel_code, source_session_type, retrieval_result, category, priority, classification_origin, classification_reason) VALUES (#{questionHash}, #{question}, #{scopeId}, 1, #{firstSeenAtMs}, #{lastSeenAtMs}, #{retrievalPath}, #{sourceAgentCode}, #{sourceChannelCode}, #{sourceSessionType}, #{retrievalResult}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{classificationOrigin}, #{classificationReason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE miss_count = miss_count + 1, retrieval_path = IF(VALUES(last_seen_at_ms) >= last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(retrieval_path), retrieval_path), source_agent_code = IF(VALUES(last_seen_at_ms) >= last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(source_agent_code), source_agent_code), source_channel_code = IF(VALUES(last_seen_at_ms) >= last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(source_channel_code), source_channel_code), source_session_type = IF(VALUES(last_seen_at_ms) >= last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(source_session_type), source_session_type), retrieval_result = IF(VALUES(last_seen_at_ms) >= last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(retrieval_result), retrieval_result), last_seen_at_ms = GREATEST(last_seen_at_ms, VALUES(last_seen_at_ms))
